subject: Request: Pilot extension and credits due to integration adapter rewrite
messages:
From: Alex Kim <alex.kim@innovaforge.com>
To: sofia_ivanova@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-07T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot blocked by adapter rewrite - request for extension and credits

Hi Sofia,

Quick note from the engineering side at InnoveForge — we've hit a blocker with the third-party payment SDK our integration depends on. The vendor shipped a breaking change that forces us to rewrite our connector; our engineers estimate ~3 weeks of work to restore the pipeline end-to-end.

We were planning the final demo at the end of this pilot window (next Tuesday), but with the rewrite we can't generate reliable traffic for the evaluation. Can Redwood provide a short pilot extension and some additional eval credits to keep the PoC moving? Specifically:
- 21-day extension on the pilot
- 75k token sandbox credit (or equivalent) to run the tests once the adapter is back

I've attached a small error bundle (error_log.zip) that shows the failure signatures. We want to avoid losing momentum — the product and stakeholders are still keen, but the timeline is slipping.

Happy to hop on a quick call if that's easier — Lee (cc'd) is our engineering manager and can walk through the failure.

Thanks,
Alex Kim
Senior Product Manager
InnoveForge

---
Attachment: error_log.zip (zip)

From: sofia_ivanova@redwood.com <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Alex Kim <alex.kim@innovaforge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-07T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot blocked by adapter rewrite - request for extension and credits

Hi Alex — thanks for the quick details and for attaching the logs. Sorry to hear about the vendor change; we see that pattern a lot and want to make it as painless as possible for customers in mid-pilot.

High-level options we can offer while we review the logs:
1) Standard extension: 14 days + 50k token sandbox credit (auto-approve)
2) Escalated support: 21 days + 75k token credit + a short dedicated CS engineering sync (requires promo approval)

If you're comfortable with option 2, I'll loop in Marissa (CS) and Ben (Sales) to confirm the promo credit and sign-off. If you'd prefer not to wait, we can provision option 1 immediately to buy some runway while we evaluate the error bundle.

Can you confirm which option you prefer and whether a short technical huddle (30min) tomorrow morning would help?

— Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference

Hi Sofia / Ben — reviewed the error bundle Alex sent. Engineering notes from our side: the failure mode looks like header-level changes from the vendor; their SDK dropped support for the legacy auth handshake and that will require a connector rewrite on InnoveForge's side. Their timeline estimate (3 weeks) seems reasonable given the work required.

Given the strategic nature of this deal (their team is already tied to our APIs and exec sponsors are watching), I'm inclined to approve the escalated option: 21-day extension + 75k token sandbox credit. A couple of asks before we finalize the promo:
- Ben: can you confirm this fits within the promotional thresholds for D-83421?
- Sofia: can you get a quick signed Mutual Action Plan (MAP) amendment — we should attach the updated milestone dates so CS and Product have alignment. I can help draft.

I recommend we offer the dedicated 30min engineering sync (we'll include Sarah from Tech Support if needed) to unblock them faster; that reduces the chance of further slipping.

If Ben confirms the promo, I'm happy to mark this as approved and prepare the credit allocation.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Alex / Lee — thanks for the context and for flagging the error bundle. We can approve the escalated package for InnoveForge on a one-time basis:

- Pilot extension: 21 days from the existing end date
- Sandbox credit: 75,000 tokens applied to your pilot environment
- Engineering sync: 30 minutes with Redwood Tech Support and CS to triage the adapter failure

Next steps:
1) Sofia — can you send the small MAP amendment (I attached a draft) to Alex for signature? We'll send a DocuSign link for the amendment and the credit allocation.
2) Alex / Lee — please confirm a time tomorrow for the engineering sync (we have 9:30 - 11:00am PT open).
3) Once the amendment is signed we'll apply the sandbox credit and extend the pilot program on our side.

Alex — good luck to your engineering team on the rewrite. We appreciate you keeping us in the loop; happy to help get this back on track.

Best,
Ben Carter
